entities.summary: Zorigtbaataryn Enkhzorig was an amateur boxer from Mongolia who competed at the 2006 Asian Games in the Featherweight division, beat Kazakastan's Galib Jafarov and ended up with the silver medal after losing against Uzbekistan's Bahodirjon Sultonov 15–37.
